title: 【沪教】八上英语阅读理解之应用文12篇.pdf

questions.stem: What does Anna want to get suggestions on?
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“I have been bullied by the boy who sits behind me. He spilled (洒) ink on my books and my hands...Can you give me some good advice?”可知，她正在遭受来自同学的欺凌，因此 她想要获得关于如何应对校园欺凌的建议。故选C。

questions.stem: According to the passage, what does Mike suggest doing?
opts: Asking the bully to stand with Anna.
Asking a friend to help Anna punish the bully.
Getting some help from the teacher.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“Finally, you should go to your teacher for help.”可知，Mike 建议向老师寻求帮 助。故选D。

questions.stem: Which is closest to the meaning of the underlined word “mean” in English?
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“talk to this bully”可知，“mean”在此处描述的是欺凌者的行为，结合语境可知， 这里指的是不友善或刻薄的意思。故选C。

questions.stem: In the letter, why did Wendy share her own experience?
opts: Because she wanted to make Anna feel happy.
Because she wanted to tell Anna to bully back.
Because she wanted to show Anna her sadness.
Because she wanted to help Anna out of trouble.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据文章可知，Wendy 分享她自己的经历是为了帮助Anna 走出困境，提供一种解 决问题的方法和鼓励。故选D。

questions.stem: By comparing Mike’s and Wendy’s suggestions, which is not TRUE?
opts: They both suggested asking others for help after being bullied.
They both thought the bullying behavior should be stopped.
They both advised Anna to take action against the bullies.
They both shared their own experiences of being bullied at school.
questions.expl: 本文讲述了Anna 被同学欺负后，向Mike 和Wendy 寻求建议的故事。Mike 和Wendy 分 别给出了他们的建议，帮助Anna 应对校园欺凌。

questions.stem: How many people were chosen to answer the questions last week?
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“One hundred persons were chosen to answer the questions last week.”可知有100 人被选中来回答问题，故选B。

questions.stem: From the survey, where do most people like to live?
questions.expl: 理解题。根据调查表可知80%的人喜欢住在绿色环保的地方，占数据大部分，故选C。

questions.stem: Which of the following is the least cared about by people according to the survey?
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“What they care about”可知Food 一栏对应的百分比最少，是15%。故选C。

questions.stem: What can we learn from the passage?
opts: 8% of the people don’t like working in Beijing.
More and more people like to plant trees now in Beijing.
We can see few old people play sports in Beijing every day.
About 20% of the people haven’t decided to change their living places.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“Whether they plan to change their living places”可知“很难说”对应的数据是 20% 。D 项“大约20%的人没有决定改变他们的居住地”符合，故选D。

questions.stem: What does the passage want to tell us?
opts: What people care about in Beijing.
What people like doing in Beijing.
How people feel about living in Beijing.
How Beijing changed the environment for people.
questions.expl: 本文是一份关于北京生活状况的小调查，调查了100 名居民的关心事项、居住偏好、对在 城里工作的看法以及是否计划改变居住地。

questions.stem: Where is this article most probably (可能) from?
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“The headmaster in No. 3 Middle School did a survey about the jobs that students are going to do when they grow up. 200 students in the school showed their answers.”可知，文章围绕第 三中学校长对学生未来职业选择的调查展开，内容贴近校园生活，最可能来自校报。故选A。

questions.stem: Which jobs are the most popular according to the pie (饼图)?
questions.expl: 理解题。根据饼状图可知，IT 工程师最受欢迎，占比35%。故选B。

questions.stem: How many students hope to be scientists in the future?
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“The headmaster in No. 3 Middle School did a survey... 200 students in the school showed their answers.”和“15% of them hope to be scientists.”可知，参与调查的学生共200 人，其中希 望成为科学家的占比15%，计算可得200×15% = 30 人。故选C。

questions.stem: Which one of the sentences is TRUE?
opts: The last 10 students choose to be football players.
Some students want to be artists from the passage.
The students in primary school showed their answers.
The writer thinks it’s great and important to have a dream.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“It’s great and important to have a dream.”可知，作者明确表达了“拥有梦想是美 好且重要的”这一观点，与选项D 表述一致。故选D。

questions.stem: What is the main topic (主题) of this passage?
opts: How to make one’s dream job come true.
The importance of different jobs in society.
The hobbies of students in No. 3 Middle School.
The survey about students’ future job choices in No. 3 Middle School.
questions.expl: 本文讲述了第三中学校长针对学生未来想从事的职业开展了一项调查并展示了调查结果。

questions.stem: What might Jenny be?
questions.expl: 判断题。根据“I don’t know how to chat (聊天) with my classmates because we do not share the same interests.”可知，Jenny 不知道如何和同学聊天，因此推测Jenny 可能是一个青少年女生。故选 A。 2. 细节理解题。根据“I don’t know how to chat (聊天) with my classmates because we do not share the same interests.”可知，Jenny 的问题是不知道如何和同学聊天。故选D。

questions.stem: What is Jenny’s problem?
opts: She is too shy to say a word in public.
She doesn’t know how to chat with her classmates.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据第二段“The announcement of the winners will take place at the awards ceremony on the afternoon of the last day.”可知，要宣布获奖者。故选C。

questions.stem: To be friendly, you can do the following EXCEPT ________.
opts: say something nice about others’ skills
give a good compliment to others
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“To make friends, you must first be friendly. Everyone likes a friendly girl with a smile. You can give your classmates a compliment (称赞). Say something nice about their dressing styles or skills.”可知，为了展现你的友好，你可以微笑，称赞他们穿衣风格或技巧。B 选项“跟更多的人 说话”并不是为了友好而可以进行的操作。故选B。

questions.stem: Who is easier to make friends with others according to the passage?
opts: John, who doesn’t want to talk to others.
Bob, who seldom says nice words to his classmates.
Tom, who doesn’t have the same interests with others.
Alice, who often asks her classmates about math questions politely.
questions.expl: 判断题。根据“Second, ask a question to start chatting...Ask your classmates questions and let them be the experts.”可知，经常礼貌地问同学数学问题的Alice 更容易交到好朋友。故选D。

questions.stem: Which of the following is TRUE according to the passage?
opts: Jenny can’t get on well with her classmates.
Jordon advises Jenny not to speak to strangers.
questions.expl: 本文主要介绍了Jenny 求助于Jordon 如何与同学交流的求助信，以及Jordon 针对Jenny 的问题给出建议的回信。

questions.stem: The Science Fair Viewing will last for ________ days.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据October 30-31 可知，持续2 天。故选D。

questions.stem: Many students will be in the gym at 1:00 on Friday afternoon because ________
opts: The winners' names will be given out.
Ray Allen will give an interview.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“The program is open to students now enrolled (登记) at one of NSE’s member schools”可知，该计划对目前就读于NSE 成员学校之一的学生开放。故选C。

questions.stem: What can we know from “Meet a Robot!”?
opts: Modo robots will be for sale.
Scientists will be at the fair on Friday
questions.expl: 理解题。根据第三段“Modo is a robot helper being developed to help people with jobs they do.” 可知，Modo 尚在发展中。故选A。

questions.stem: From the Science Fair Schedule, we can know that________.
opts: The Awards Presentation will be held after the Science Fair Viewing.
Students can see the robot at 5:00 p.m. on October 29.
The Set-up of projects will last for five hours a day from October 28 to 29.
questions.expl: 本文是一篇广告布告类短文。主要介绍了阳光中学科学博览会的日期、参与人员、地点、 以及主要的活动内容。

questions.stem: What can you NOT get from the NSE?
opts: Work and live in the host country in the future.B. Learn from different teachers.
Experience life from a different culture.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“You can take part in NSE to: broaden (开阔) your mind...learn from different teachers... experience a different growth...find new ways of study...learn to live by yourself...experience life from a different culture”可知可以拓宽你的思维，向不同的老师学习，体验不同的成长，寻找新 的学习方法，学会独立生活，体验不同文化的生活，故选A。

questions.stem: Who can take part in this programme?
opts: Cindy from an NSE’s member school.
questions.expl: 理解题。由Science of Cake 部分的“Join scientist Subha Nasir Ahmad in a talk about some of the science of baking and see a cake-decorating show using skills drawn from science.”可知，参与该活动的 人可以见到Subha Nasir Ahmad。故选D。

questions.stem: Where may you read this passage?
questions.expl: 本文是一则有关交换生的广告信息，介绍了学生交换计划这个项目的内容。

questions.stem: What can you get if you visit Powerhouse Museum on 13 August?
questions.expl: 理解题。由Print Your Voice 部分的“where your voice will be turned into your own jewellery” 和“Address: Powerhouse Museum”可知，8 月13 日到Powerhouse Museum 参加活动的访客均可得到 一份首饰。故选C。

questions.stem: What can visitors do when they attend Science of Cake?
questions.expl: 理解题。根据第一个表格里的三个问句可知，分别与B、C、D 三个选项相符。故选A。

questions.stem: A 13-year-old girl and her parents will join the robot workshop, how much will they pay?
questions.expl: 判断题。本文是一则有关交换生的广告信息，可以在网站上看到，故选A。

questions.stem: What can we know about the four activities?
opts: All are related to (与……有关) science.
All take place on the weekend.
questions.expl: 本文是应用文，文章对4 个科学活动进行介绍。

questions.stem: We can find this material from ________.
questions.expl: 判断题。根据第一个表格最后一句“The SPORTS FANS is the only sports website you’ll ever need.”可推测出，这份材料来自网站。故选A。

questions.stem: The person who wants to ________ may NOT need the “SPORTS FANS”.
opts: look for the latest scores of sports
connect with fans of famous football players
know more information about his favorite tennis players
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“…where you will have a chance to experience the world’s longest and highest glass bridge, Zhangjiajie Glass Bridge.”可知，世界上最长、最高的玻璃桥是张家界玻璃桥。故选C。

questions.stem: The live score of ________ ISN’T mentioned in this reading material.
questions.expl: 理解题。由Learn to Code (编码) with Robotics 部分的“Tickets: Adult (ages≥18) $20, Teenager (ages 15-17) $15, Child (ages 10-14) $10”可知13 岁的女孩票价10 美元，父母每人20 美元，共支付 50 美元。故选C。

questions.stem: You can find out your favorite teams and players through ________.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“Awards Presentation October 31”和“Science Fair Viewing October 30 - 31”可知， 颁奖典礼将于科学展参观后举行，故选A。

questions.stem: The underlined sentence means new members ________.
opts: have to pay 30 dollars for the service online
can design the sports website with other 30 fans
can use the sports website without paying for one month
can get the information from the sports website for only a month
questions.expl: 理解题。通过比较Mike 和Wendy 的建议可知，发现他们都建议在被欺凌后寻求他人帮助， 认为应该制止欺凌行为，并建议Anna 采取行动对抗欺凌者。但只有Wendy 分享了她自己的被欺凌 经历，而Mike 并没有。故选D。

questions.stem: The main purpose of the reading material above is ________.
opts: to introduce great players and teams
to encourage users to write about sports
to teach users how to be better players
to invite people to join the SPORTS FANS
questions.expl: 本文是一篇应用文。文章是一篇广告，介绍了“SPORTS FANS”这个网站的一些信息。

questions.stem: What will the visitors do on Day 1?
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“Laoshe Teahouse... Visitors can enjoy tea and Beijing-style (北京风格) snacks and watch traditional Chinese opera shows there.”可知，老舍茶馆能让游客品尝京味小吃，所以想享受京 味小吃应该去老舍茶馆。故选D。

questions.stem: What is the world’s longest and highest glass bridge?
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“Laoshe Teahouse... Price: 10 yuan (non-members) and 5 yuan (members)”可知， 老舍茶馆非会员票价10 元，会员票价5 元，那么两名会员和一名非会员的总费用是5×2 + 10 = 20 元。故选C。

questions.stem: What can visitors enjoy on Day 3?
questions.expl: 理解题。根据左下表格中“live scores from baseball, football, basketball, soccer, hockey, tennis, cricket, bowling, volleyball, table tennis, and other sports around the world.”可知，没有提及“bicycle”。 故选C。

questions.stem: What can we know about Travel China Guide from the text?
opts: It can book the hotel after your arrival.
It is designed for Chinese visitors.
It provides traveling services for foreign tourists.
questions.expl: 判断题。由这4 个活动内容介绍中的关键信息“the science of our voice”，“create your future just with the technology” ，“the science of baking…using skills drawn from science” 及“Code with Robotics”可知，这4 个活动都与科学有关。故选B。

questions.stem: In which part of a magazine can the article be found?
questions.expl: 本文介绍了为期三天的张家界深度游。

questions.stem: If you want to enjoy Beijing-style snacks, you should go to ________.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“If you have your own Acme Rocket Launcher, you can create and send up rockets that show off your personality and creativity.”可知，如果你有自己的Acme 火箭发射器，你可以创建 和发射火箭来展示你的个性和创造力。故选C。

questions.stem: What’s the price for two members and one non-member to watch an opera show in LaosheTeahouse?
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“Clean the cola bottle from outside to inside and allow it to dry.”可知，瓶子要 干净和干燥。故选C。

questions.stem: What can’t we learn about Huguang Guild Hall from the passage?
opts: Its beginning time of the shows.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“Day 3 Away From Zhangjiajie：Today your Zhangjiajie tour will continue to go to the Tianmen Mountain,”可知，第三天游客可以游玩天门山。故选C。

questions.stem: Which of the following is TRUE?
opts: Chang’an Grand Theater is one of the four traditional theaters in Beijing.
Huguang Guild Hall can hold 800 people at most.
Only young people can enjoy themselves in China Puppet Theater.
Laoshe Teahouse was named after the famous writer, Lao She.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据左下表格最后一条“personal home pages that allow you to find out your favorite teams and players.”可知，是通过“personal home pages”。故选B。

questions.stem: Where can we read this text?
questions.expl: 本文是一篇应用文，主要讲了北京的湖广会馆、长安大戏院、老舍茶馆和中国木偶剧院这 四家剧院的特色、票价、联系电话及网址等信息，并提示可通过相关网站了解更多内容。

questions.stem: What can you do with your own Acme Rocket Launcher according to the text?
questions.expl: 判断题。根据诗后的第一段中的“When Tang Dynasty poet Du Fu (712-770) wrote this poem, he was living in Chengdu”可知，770 减712 等于58，杜甫在58 岁时去世的，故选A。

questions.stem: Which of the following is TRUE about the bottle?
opts: It can be of any size.
It must be made of glass.
It should be clean and dry.
It needs to be filled with cola.
questions.expl: 大意题。根据诗后第一段中的“The poem shows his care for farmers”可知，这首诗表达了对农 民的关怀，故选C。

questions.stem: The rocket’s nose cone is rolled from ________.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“Huguang Guild Hall... It is one of the four traditional (传统的) theaters in Beijing. Most of the shows begin at 7:30 p.m. Price: 70 yuan each person Tel: 010-63518284”可知，文中提到了 湖广会馆的演出开始时间、票价和电话号码，没有提到它的建成年代(即年龄)。故选A。

questions.stem: What can you get from Step 4?
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“As a popular tour operator, Travel China Guide designs a lot of China tour packages (旅游套餐) for foreigners with the best-selling travel deals to wonderful must-see destinations and offers the best quality services.”可知，Travel China Guide 是专为外国游客提供旅游服务的。故选 D。 5. 推理判断题。根据“As a popular tour operator, Travel China Guide designs a lot of China tour packages (旅游套餐) for foreigners with the best-selling travel deals to wonderful must-see destinations and offers the best quality services.”可推知，这篇文章可以在杂志的旅行部分找到。故选A。

questions.stem: The main purpose of the text is to ________.
opts: give instructions on making a rocket
questions.expl: 本文主要讲述了制作火箭所需要的材料及制作过程。

questions.stem: The poet Du Fu died when he was ________ years old.
What’s the main idea of the poem according to the text?
opts: The poet’s love for the wind.
The poet’s care for the field.

questions.stem: Which of the following is mentioned in the text?①wind ②snowstorm ③cloud ④rainbow ⑤thunder
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“Roll (卷起) the large triangle so that two of its sides touch and it forms a rocket’ s nose cone.”可知，火箭的鼻锥是从大三角形上卷下来的。故选D。

questions.stem: Why does the poet use the word “knows” in the first line of the poem?
opts: To show the farmer’s busy work.
To tell the right time of rain coming.
questions.expl: 本文主要介绍了杜甫的一首诗《春夜喜雨》，并介绍了诗中蕴含的意义。
